author: pucci
text:
Hi Deenius,

Yes you are. However try to incorporate the sequences of h-l-hh-hl-hh-ll-lh-ll or (hh-hl-lh-ll) etc... even if it's only in your minds eye. Now go back over the charts you posted and look at the X areas. You will find that often a good demand for instance is one that is a higher low that either made a hh or is part of the base where the downtrend sequence shifted giving you the lowest low that is also often a qm zone.

Hope this helps,
